title: Claude Feature 04: PDF aur photo upload karke sawal poochho #shorts
description:
Claude Feature 04 (Claude for Everyone): files upload karna. Chat box ka plus button, Add files or photos, file chuno, ya drag and drop. PDF, Word, CSV, text aur photos chalte hain, ek chat me 20 files tak. 100 page tak ke PDF me Claude chart aur tasveerein bhi padhta hai, usse bade PDF me sirf text. Page ka sawal ho to PDF viewer wala page number batao.

Source (official):
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8241126-upload-files-to-claude

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the docs screenshot is our own capture of the official help page (key line highlighted). The app screen is an illustration. Synthetic voice.
